scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.test:backend: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && uv run pytest) || exit 1; done
scripts.stop: docker compose down --remove-orphans && (lsof -ti :5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; true)
